title: multi check names duplicate research when the coord store is shared and measures it when isolated
goal: with a shared coord store multi check exits 1 naming each pair of agents that added a fact for one research term a live dedup claim of the other agent held; with --coord isolated it prints the duplicates it counts as a measurement and does not fail on them; --plant dup-research makes two replayed research agents skip coord.py dedup and add the same planted fact

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, "bin"); os.mkdir(B)
MARK = os.path.join(T, "claude-was-started")
open(os.path.join(B, "claude"), "w").write("#!/bin/sh\necho started >> " + MARK + "\nexit 1\n")
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, "claude"), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ["PATH"])
def bench(*a, ok=(0,), timeout=1200):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/benchmarks.py", *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=timeout)
    assert r.returncode in ok, (a, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:], r.stderr[-600:])
    return r

cases = ((["--coord", "shared"], 0, None), (["--coord", "shared", "--plant", "dup-research"], 1, "duplicate research"),
         (["--coord", "isolated", "--plant", "dup-research"], 0, "duplicate"))
for i, (extra, code, word) in enumerate(cases):
    d = os.path.join(T, str(i))
    bench("multi", "run", "research", "--replay", "--dir", d, *extra)
    r = bench("multi", "check", "--dir", d, ok=(0, 1))
    assert r.returncode == code and (word is None or word in r.stdout), (extra, r.returncode, r.stdout[-600:])
